title: Aerated and Lemony Venezuelan Yeast Bowl
description: This recipe is a nostalgic Venezuelan dish with a light and airy texture, featuring lemon zest and a low-calorie-friendly puff.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a small bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, salt, and lemon zest.
Add melted butter and almond milk to the dry ingredients. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased earthenware bowl and cover it with plastic wrap.
Let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Gently punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf.
Place the loaf in the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the loaf from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
